title: Microsoft Purview Endpoint DLP: read-only access to device onboarding with View-Only Device Management
summary: The briefing accurately distinguishes the planned read-only role from the currently documented Entra-only access. Two minor corrections remain: carry the role-group path through to membership selection, and acknowledge published Endpoint DLP licensing while retaining the narrower role-specific licensing question.

claims.where: front matter: licensing; Cost and licensing; Open questions; rationale: cost
claims.claim: Licensing specific to this planned read-only access is unpublished, so the page uses licensing.model unknown.
claims.quote:
| Feature | Microsoft 365 E5/A5/G5, Microsoft Purview Suite/EDU/GOV/FLW and Microsoft Defender + Purview Suite FLW, Microsoft 365 E5/A5/F5/G5 Information Protection & Governance |
| --- | --- |
| Endpoint Data Loss Prevention (DLP) | Included |
claims.fix: Set licensing.model to 'included'. Set licensing.notes to 'Endpoint DLP is included in Microsoft 365 E5/A5/G5 and the other plans listed in the Microsoft Purview service description. Users assigned a Purview role for the portal require a licence; a licence specific to this planned read-only access is not yet published.' Add the sentence 'Endpoint DLP is included in Microsoft 365 E5/A5/G5 and the other plans listed in the Microsoft Purview service description.' before the existing role-specific licensing gap in Cost and licensing. Keep the narrower role-specific question and the low incremental cost rating.
